WOODY.name: Woody
WOODY.description: A warm and natural aroma reminiscent of dry wood and bark. It carries a stable, organic character with a slightly rough edge.

PINE.name: Pine
PINE.description: Fresh, resinous, and penetrating, similar to a conifer forest. Its balsamic character makes it instantly recognizable.

CEDAR.name: Cedar
CEDAR.description: Aromatic wood with a dry and elegant tone. Offers a clean, slightly spicy profile typical of fine woods.

SANDALWOOD.name: Sandalwood
SANDALWOOD.description: Sweet, creamy, and smooth, with a warm and enveloping character. Evokes refined woods with a soft, perfumed touch.

RESINOUS.name: Resinous
RESINOUS.description: A dense, sticky aroma reminiscent of fresh sap. It has a deep, slightly sweet aromatic profile.

BALSAMIC.name: Balsamic
BALSAMIC.description: Sweet and refreshing, with a soft medicinal nuance. Its aromatic character is stable and gently enveloping.

OAK.name: Oak
OAK.description: Toasted wood with a dry and firm profile. Offers a deep, slightly rough aromatic tone.

CITRUS.name: Citrus
CITRUS.description: Fresh and sparkling, with notes reminiscent of lemon or orange peel. Its volatile nature makes it easy to identify.

LEMON.name: Lemon
LEMON.description: Bright and acidic, similar to lemon zest. Presents a lively, fresh profile that stands out quickly.

ORANGE.name: Orange
ORANGE.description: Sweet and juicy, with a soft tone reminiscent of ripe fruit. Warm and pleasant in character.

GRAPEFRUIT.name: Grapefruit
GRAPEFRUIT.description: A citrus aroma with a fresh, slightly bitter edge. Lively and subtly dry, easy to distinguish.

LIME.name: Lime
LIME.description: Green, acidic, and refreshing. Its light, volatile character gives a bright aromatic sensation.

TANGY.name: Tangy
TANGY.description: A lively, sharp aroma with a characteristic sour sensation. Fresh and energetic in tone.

SOUR.name: Sour
SOUR.description: Intense and sharp notes reminiscent of unripe fruit. Lively and slightly abrasive.

BERRY.name: Berry
BERRY.description: Sweet and fruity, similar to ripe berries. Juicy and soft, easy to identify.

GRAPE.name: Grape
GRAPE.description: A sweet, fruity aroma reminiscent of purple grapes or must. Rounded and slightly dense.

APPLE.name: Apple
APPLE.description: Fresh and crisp, similar to green apple. Clean and lightly acidic.

PEACH.name: Peach
PEACH.description: Sweet and juicy, with a soft fruity tone. Warm and pleasant in character.

APRICOT.name: Apricot
APRICOT.description: Sweet and fleshy fruit with a mild honeyed nuance. Soft and lightly perfumed.

PLUM.name: Plum
PLUM.description: Deep sweetness with a slightly acidic edge. Fruity and mature in profile.

LYCHEE.name: Lychee
LYCHEE.description: Sweet, floral, and exotic, with a juicy character. Soft and highly recognizable.

FRUITY.name: Fruity
FRUITY.description: A sweet, fresh blend of ripe fruits. Lively and pleasant aromatic character.

SWEET.name: Sweet
SWEET.description: A soft, sugary aroma with a light and pleasant tone. Warm and gentle in sensation.

HONEY.name: Honey
HONEY.description: Warm, thick sweetness reminiscent of natural honey. Smooth and enveloping.

SUGAR.name: Sugar
SUGAR.description: Simple, direct sweetness similar to white sugar. Light and clean aroma.

CANDY.name: Candy
CANDY.description: Intense sweetness reminiscent of confectionery. Bright, youthful aromatic profile.

AMBER.name: Amber
AMBER.description: Sweet, warm, and resinous with a deep tone. Soft and lightly perfumed aroma.

FLORAL.name: Floral
FLORAL.description: Soft and perfumed, similar to fresh flowers. Delicate and slightly sweet character.

ROSE.name: Rose
ROSE.description: Sweet and elegant, reminiscent of fresh petals. Smooth and perfumed aroma.

LAVENDER.name: Lavender
LAVENDER.description: Herbal and floral with a calming nuance. Soft and balanced aromatic profile.

LILAC.name: Lilac
LILAC.description: Sweet and gentle, with a light floral tone. Evokes delicate, perfumed blossoms.

JASMINE.name: Jasmine
JASMINE.description: Intense, sweet, and exotic floral aroma. Deep and highly characteristic.

VIOLET.name: Violet
VIOLET.description: Sweet and powdery with a delicate floral nuance. Soft and elegant character.

HERBAL.name: Herbal
HERBAL.description: Green and aromatic, like a blend of fresh herbs. Clean and natural profile.

GRASSY.name: Grassy
GRASSY.description: Green and lively, similar to freshly cut grass. Light and bright character.

GREEN.name: Green
GREEN.description: Fresh and vegetal, reminiscent of crushed leaves. Natural and soft aromatic tone.

TEA.name: Tea
TEA.description: Soft and herbal, similar to light infusions. Delicate and balanced aroma.

HAY.name: Hay
HAY.description: Dry and vegetal, reminiscent of cured grasses. Soft and slightly warm profile.

EUCALYPTUS.name: Eucalyptus
EUCALYPTUS.description: Fresh and minty with a balsamic nuance. Clean and penetrating aroma.

MINTY.name: Minty
MINTY.description: Fresh and penetrating, with a cool sensation. Lively and stimulating aromatic character.

MENTHOL.name: Menthol
MENTHOL.description: Very fresh and volatile, with an intense tone. Clean and instantly recognizable aroma.

SPEARMINT.name: Spearmint
SPEARMINT.description: Sweet and refreshing, softer than mint. Light and pleasant aromatic profile.

SPICY.name: Spicy
SPICY.description: Warm and aromatic, reminiscent of mild spices. Lively and slightly sharp character.

PEPPERY.name: Peppery
PEPPERY.description: Dry and sharp, similar to black pepper. Strong and penetrating aroma.

CLOVES.name: Cloves
CLOVES.description: Sweet and spicy with a warm nuance. Deep and aromatic profile.

CINNAMON.name: Cinnamon
CINNAMON.description: Sweet and warm, highly aromatic. Smooth and enveloping character.

GINGER.name: Ginger
GINGER.description: Sharp and fresh with a lightly citrus edge. Lively and stimulating aroma.

ANISE.name: Anise
ANISE.description: Sweet and herbal, reminiscent of licorice. Soft and perfumed profile.

PUNGENT.name: Pungent
PUNGENT.description: Strong and penetrating aroma with a sharp character. Intense and direct profile.

SHARP.name: Sharp
SHARP.description: Agile and vivid, perceived quickly. Clear and direct aromatic tone.

ACRID.name: Acrid
ACRID.description: Dry and harsh, with an irritating edge. Strong and marked aromatic profile.

EARTHY.name: Earthy
EARTHY.description: Deep and organic aroma reminiscent of dry soil and minerals. Stable and natural character.

MUSKY.name: Musky
MUSKY.description: Deep and slightly animalic with a soft sweetness. Dense and enveloping aroma.

MUSTY.name: Musty
MUSTY.description: Muted and stale, similar to stored materials. Dense, low‑volatility aromatic character.

MOSSY.name: Mossy
MOSSY.description: Green and soft, like vegetation on stone. Natural and slightly muted profile.

PATCHOULI.name: Patchouli
PATCHOULI.description: Earthy and sweet with a deep herbal nuance. Warm and enveloping aroma.

TOBACCO.name: Tobacco
TOBACCO.description: Dry and warm, reminiscent of cured leaves. Firm and characteristic aromatic tone.

LEATHER.name: Leather
LEATHER.description: Strong and warm, similar to natural leather. Deep and slightly rough aroma.

FUEL.name: Fuel
FUEL.description: Chemical and penetrating, similar to light vapors. Volatile and marked profile.

GAS.name: Gas
GAS.description: Dry, sharp chemical aroma. Strong and volatile character.

DIESEL.name: Diesel
DIESEL.description: Intense fuel-like aroma with a dry edge. Strong and recognizable profile.

KEROSENE.name: Kerosene
KEROSENE.description: Sharp and chemical, similar to clean fuel. Penetrating and volatile aroma.

CHEMICAL.name: Chemical
CHEMICAL.description: Synthetic and strong, with a dry tone. Volatile and direct aromatic profile.

SOLVENT.name: Solvent
SOLVENT.description: Strong, volatile aroma reminiscent of cleaning agents. Penetrating and marked character.

CHEESY.name: Cheesy
CHEESY.description: Fermented and creamy with an intense tone. Strong and slightly salty aroma.

SKUNK.name: Skunk
SKUNK.description: Highly penetrating with an animalic and herbal character. Strong and distinctive profile.

SULFUROUS.name: Sulfurous
SULFUROUS.description: Harsh and strong, reminiscent of sulfur compounds. Intense and marked aroma.

FUNKY.name: Funky
FUNKY.description: Intense and unconventional, with fermented nuances and a soft animalic touch. Complex and distinctive profile.

STINKY.name: Stinky
STINKY.description: Strong and unpleasant, with a highly penetrating character. Aggressive aromatic profile.

ROTTEN.name: Rotten
ROTTEN.description: Aroma reminiscent of overly aged fruit or degraded material. Strong and easily recognizable.

SWEATY.name: Sweaty
SWEATY.description: Animalic and salty, similar to dried sweat. Intense and marked aromatic tone.

MEDICINAL.name: Medicinal
MEDICINAL.description: Clean, chemical aroma reminiscent of mild ointments. Fresh and penetrating character.

CAMPHOR.name: Camphor
CAMPHOR.description: Fresh and penetrating with a balsamic nuance. Strong and volatile aroma.

WAXY.name: Waxy
WAXY.description: Soft and neutral, similar to wax or paraffin. Light and stable aromatic profile.

OILY.name: Oily
OILY.description: Greasy and dense, with a heavy sensation. Smooth and persistent aroma.

MUSTARD.name: Mustard
MUSTARD.description: Sharp and sulfurous, reminiscent of strong mustard. Penetrating and vivid aromatic character.
